interpretation: Four conditions have byte-identical initial integration, randomized-model, controller, observation and RNG state within each platform for every seed.
Linux zero7/14, small noise exp(-4)12/14, initial noise exp(-2)2/14, frozen40k deterministic policy0/14. Mac9/14,12/14,2/14,0/14.
High noise causes10/14 penetration or displacement aborts on each platform; smaller noise gives a promising local result, not a trained policy or formal acceptance.
The40k mean policy survives7s but fails loaded opposition in all14; it also accumulates joint-command drift, with mean peak offset about0.257rad Linux and0.255rad Mac.
Early failures therefore are not explained by stochastic noise alone. Learned action means can integrate to position drift under velocity actions.
No physical parameters, task gates, rewards, reset selection or running-pilot parameters changed. Complete its frozen budget and original formal gate first.
If needed, a subsequent separately budgeted pilot may test smaller initial exploration and zero initial action means; new formal seeds and preserved failed results are required.
